tagline: Argus取景器相机，1936 年发布
description: Argus于1936年推出的取景器相机。配备f/4.5 anastigmat。快门速度1/200th sec, 1/100, 1/50, 1/25, B(ulb), T(ime)。2 Position (6ft - 12ft and 12ft - Infinity, later 6ft - 18ft and 18ft - Infinity)。

specs.对焦: 2 Position (6ft - 12ft and 12ft - Infinity, later 6ft - 18ft and 18ft - Infinity)
specs.英文简介: Possibly the most important 35mm American camera, the Argus A was largely responsible for popularizing the 135 format in the United States.
